center.title: Notifications
center.empty: All caught up. Even the moon takes a break 🌙
center.error: Couldn't load right now. Try again?

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp queue
whatsapp.subtitle: Ready-made messages to send from your WhatsApp. Tap "Send", confirm in WhatsApp and come back to mark it as done.
whatsapp.empty: No messages in the queue. Inbox zero, baby ✨

announcements.title: Announcements
announcements.subtitle: Write it once and it reaches the notification center, e-mail and your WhatsApp queue.
announcements.messagePlaceholder: E.g. No lesson on the Nov 15 holiday. Enjoy! 🎉
announcements.sent: Announcement sent to {count, plural, one {# student} other {# students}} ✨
announcements.whatsappQueued: {count, plural, =0 {No messages went to the WhatsApp queue.} one {# message went to the WhatsApp queue.} other {# messages went to the WhatsApp queue.}}

errors.tooLong: The message is too long (2,000 characters max).
errors.meetingLink: Announcements can't include a meeting link: it only lives on the lesson page 😉

lessonTomorrow.title: Lesson tomorrow! 🌙
lessonTomorrow.body: Your lesson is tomorrow, {weekday}, at {time}. Don't forget, see you there 👋
lessonTomorrow.whatsapp: Hi, {name}! Quick reminder: you have a lesson tomorrow ({weekday}) at {time} 🌙 Everything is on the lesson page: {url}

lessonInOneHour.title: Your lesson starts in 1 hour 🌙
lessonInOneHour.body: Today at {time}. Open the lesson in the platform and tap "Join lesson". Let's go!

chargeDueSoon.title: Your monthly fee is due in 3 days 💸

chargeOverdue.title: Your monthly fee is overdue
chargeOverdue.body: The {amount} charge due on {date} is still open. Shall we sort it out?

blockWarning.title: Heads up: your access may be blocked
blockWarning.body: The {amount} charge is overdue. If it isn't paid by {date}, access to lessons will be blocked.

priceChange.title: Monthly fee update
priceChange.body: Starting {date}, your monthly fee will be {amount}.

creditExpiring.title: Your lesson credit expires in 3 days ⏳

lessonRequestAccepted.title: Lesson request accepted ✅
lessonRequestAccepted.body: Your lesson on {weekday}, {date}, at {time} is confirmed.

lessonRequestRejected.title: Lesson request declined
lessonRequestRejected.body: We couldn't confirm the lesson on {date} at {time}. Want to try another time?

lessonCancelledByTeacher.title: Lesson cancelled
lessonCancelledByTeacher.body: The lesson on {weekday}, {date}, at {time} was cancelled by the teacher.

lessonRequested.title: New lesson request
lessonRequested.body: {student} asked for a lesson on {date} at {time}.

newStudent.title: New student! 🎉
newStudent.body: {student} accepted the invite and joined the platform.
